verification_methodology_note: Capital Market Law «نظام السوق المالية» — Royal Decree M/30 dated 2/6/1424H (31 July 2003, King Fahd bin Abdulaziz Al Saud), approved by Council of Ministers Resolution 91 (16/4/1424H) following Shura Council Resolution 44/47 (25/10/1423H). Administering authority: Capital Market Authority (CMA, هيئة السوق المالية). MIXED-TIER TRACK: the 2003 original text (67 articles) is fully verified with HIGH confidence via laws.boe.gov.sa (primary source, reached via r.jina.ai this pass). The law has since been substantially amended, principally by Royal Decree M/16 (19/1/1441H, Cabinet Decision 52/1441, ~17 September 2019 approval), which restructured the Market/Depository/Clearing-Center regime, relocated the disputes-committee provision into a new Chapter 4 (now Article 30), and rewrote the penalties regime (Article 59). An earlier candidate amending instrument, Royal Decree M/24 (15/3/1443H), was investigated and CONFIRMED UNRELATED -- it amends the Finance Companies Supervision Law, a different statute entirely. Across three research passes (direct cma.gov.sa fetches with WAF-avoidance spacing, Wayback Machine fallback for two WAF-broken pages, PDF cross-checks), the CURRENT verbatim text was independently recovered and verified for the large majority of articles -- either because the article is CONFIRMED UNCHANGED from 2003 (word-for-word match) or because the amended current text was directly fetched in full. For 12 articles (1, 20, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 59) -- precisely the articles at the core of the M/16 restructuring -- the exact current verbatim wording could NOT be recovered despite three research passes (CMA's WAF, a genuinely broken Chapter 8 sub-page for related content, and laws.boe.gov.sa's TLS-reset blocking every attempt to read M/16's own gazette text). Per this corpus's zero-fabrication policy, these 12 articles are ingested using the 2003 ORIGINAL text as a clearly-flagged HISTORICAL placeholder, NOT presented as current law -- each carries its own verification_tier field (ORIGINAL_2003_TEXT_ONLY_CURRENT_WORDING_CONFIRMED_AMENDED_UNVERIFIED) distinct from the track's main tier, and a dedicated known_unresolved_discrepancies entry. A 68th record, Article 20 مكرر (a new inserted article), is RECONSTRUCTED from the research agent's explicit description that it 'verbatim relocates paragraphs (ج) and (د) of the original Article 20' -- flagged with its own lower-confidence tier, not a direct fetch. The current chapter (فصل) map could not be fully reconstructed given the Article-30 relocation into a new Chapter 4; chapter_structure is left empty (flat) rather than asserting an unconfirmed map -- only Chapter 8 (arts 49-50) and Chapter 10 (arts 55-67) boundaries are independently confirmed and are documented in the methodology note rather than as a false gapless structure. A companion CMA PDF (CMA_Law.pdf) was used only for spot-checking (its font scrambles multi-line paragraph order in extraction), never as a primary wording source. This is the most complex verification case handled in this corpus to date -- a mixed-confidence track is used explicitly rather than either fabricating the unrecovered articles' current wording or blocking ingestion of the 55 (of 67) articles that ARE fully verified.

Its text was NOT independently fetched as a standalone current-text block; it is RECONSTRUCTED from the research agent's explicit description that this article 'verbatim relocates paragraphs (ج) and (د) of the original Article 20' -- i.e. the 2003 original's own paragraphs ج (market objectives) and د (dividend-distribution prohibition) are used here per that documented relocation description. verification_tier = RECONSTRUCTED_FROM_DOCUMENTED_RELOCATION_DESCRIPTION -- a lower-confidence reconstruction, not a direct fetch. Flagged for independent confirmation in a follow-up pass.

Article 16's exact current text was not independently re-fetched in this build (2003 original used, confirmed unchanged in substance per both research passes' silence on any Article 16 amendment) -- included here only as a general note that Article 16 (5% ownership-change threshold definitions) interacts with Articles 52-54's restricted-purchase/tender-offer provisions, which were independently confirmed unchanged.

The amending instrument for the Market/Depository/Clearing-Center restructuring is CONFIRMED as Royal Decree M/16 (19/1/1441H, corresponding Cabinet Decision 52/1441, approved ~17 September 2019) via two independent secondary sources (Lexis Middle East's legislative tracker; Argaam financial news, which reports the Cabinet decision specifically addressing Article 30). An earlier candidate, Royal Decree M/24 (15/3/1443H), was investigated and CONFIRMED to be UNRELATED -- it amends a different law (the Finance Companies Supervision Law) entirely, and is explicitly excluded from consideration here. The FULL list of articles M/16 touched beyond Article 30 could not be independently confirmed from a primary source (laws.boe.gov.sa TLS-reset on every attempt; crsd.gov.sa DNS timeout on every attempt) -- the article-by-article amendment determinations in this track rest on direct cma.gov.sa fetches comparing current vs. 2003 text, not on a primary reading of M/16's own gazette text.

The current chapter (فصل) map could not be fully reconstructed this pass -- Article 30's relocation into a new dedicated Chapter 4 (per the M/16 restructuring) shifted subsequent chapter boundaries in a way not fully traced. Only Chapter 8 (arts 49-50, 'الفصل الثامن: الاحتيال والتداول بناء على معلومات داخلية') and Chapter 10 (arts 55-67, 'الفصل العاشر: العقوبات واحكام الجزائية للمخالفات') boundaries are independently confirmed via CMA breadcrumbs/PDF headers. chapter_structure is left empty (flat) rather than asserting an unconfirmed full gapless map. Candidate for follow-up.

**تنبيه سريان**: النسخة المُستوعبة هنا منشورة بتاريخ 2003-08-01، وقد رصد تدقيق السريان (scripts/audit_corpus_currency.py) إشعار تعديل واحداً في أرشيف جريدة أم القرى **بعد** هذا التاريخ، يحمل عنوانه اسم هذه الأداة بكل كلماته المميِّزة ونوعها ذاته (نظام): 2026-07-10 — الموافقة على تعديل المادة السابعة من نظام السوق المالية (https://www.uqn.gov.sa/decisions-and-regulations/4001340). **الإشعار ليس نص التعديل**، ولذلك لا يُدَّعى هنا شيء عن مضمونه ولم يُعدَّل نص أي مادة استناداً إليه. والمطابقة على العنوان لا على المتن، وقد يَرِد اسم أداة داخل عنوانٍ موضوعُه أداة مجاورة، فالصفحة الرسمية المذكورة هي الفيصل. المُفصَح عنه هو أن نص هذا المسار **قد لا يكون محدَّثاً**. يُرفع هذا التنبيه فقط عند استيعاب النص المعدَّل من مصدر رسمي. (تاريخ الطبعة أعلاه محسوب من التاريخ الهجري المُثبَت في المصدر، لا مقروءاً من ترويسة الجريدة؛ وقد اشتُرط فارق ثلاثين يوماً على الأقل حتى لا يُنتج خطأ التحويل تنبيهاً كاذباً.)
